accepted.label: Similarity Queries with Gensim
accepted.description: After transforming a corpus with a model (e.g., TF-IDF), Gensim can compute similarity scores between a query document and all documents in the corpus, enabling search and clustering.
coverage_criteria: Explain how to perform a similarity query in Gensim.
Interpret similarity scores from a given output.
Sort documents by relevance using similarity scores.
accepted.merge_rationale: This candidate represents a distinct teachable concept about performing similarity queries, shown as a key application in the source. It stands alone as a lesson-local concept.
